info.cls_ename: Department of Information Engineering and Computer Science

description.describe_ch: 本課程主要目的是教導學生開發Responsive Web應用程式的知識與能力。Responsive Web設計可以針對不同的裝置提供相對應的呈現與使用方式。本課程將以Web應用程式前端相關語言、技術、功能以及Responsive Web設計方法進行介紹與實作演練。在完成此一課程後，學生將能夠應用所學的程式語言、軟體架構與開發工具來實作高品質與良好使用者體驗的Web應用程式。
description.describe_eh: The purpose of this course is to teach students knowledge and skills of the development of Responsive Web applications. Responsive Web design can provide adaptive user interfaces according to various devices. This course presents introductions and practices including relevant languages, technologies and responsive designs required for building Web applications. Upon completion of this course, students can leverage the languages, software architectures and tools to develop applications with high quality and good user experience.
